label: PF Backlog 213
title: Backend: single source for paths (core/paths.py ROOT + derived dirs; relative-to-root, not CWD)
body:
## Problem / why
The repo root is recomputed in many modules via os.path.dirname(...) chains and paths are opened
CWD-relative; there is no single source. Moving the product (BI-0203) needs one authoritative root.

## Goal & value
ONE module (core/paths.py) exposes ROOT (absolute, from __file__, PF_ROOT-env override) + derived dirs
(PRODUCTS_DIR, CONFIG_DIR, DOCS_DIR, FORGE_HOME, FORGE_DATA_DIR, ...). All code derives paths from
ROOT (relative to ROOT - never CWD, never absolute literals, no dirname chains).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Only core/paths.py computes the repo root; every other module imports from it.
- Running a command from any CWD yields identical paths.
- grep: no new os.path.dirname(dirname(...)) root computations.

## Dependencies & links
- Part of BI-0203 (repo restructure). FORGE_DATA_DIR concept from the data-move decision.

## Verification / test plan
- Run tests from repo root AND a subdir; identical results; compileall + wired_audit green.
